sources.title: Streaming Sortformer - Learn AI
sources.snippet: Streaming Sortformer is a real-time speaker diarization model developed by NVIDIA as part of its NeMo framework for conversational AI. Released in August 2025, the model identifies and labels individual speakers in live audio streams, assigning consistent speaker tags as each participant enters a conversation.
